youtube_short.title: Cyber Monday Costs You $1,900 — Here's How
title_alternatives: The Cyber Monday Scam Nobody Talks About
youtube_short.description:
Cyber Monday was invented by a marketing firm in 2005 to extend Black Friday hype. 92% of deals are the same price or cheaper outside of Cyber Week — the 'original' price was never real. The average shopper plans $400 and walks away spending $1,900. That gap isn't bad math. It's decades of behavioral engineering. Here's exactly how the trap works — and how to beat it. #cybermonday #personalfinance #moneytips #savemoney

Check price history before buying. CamelCamelCamel for Amazon, Google Shopping everywhere else. That deal ending in 2 hours? It'll be back tomorrow.

hook_line: Cyber Monday was invented in 2005. Those deals aren't real.
